rules.label: 臓器提供意思表示欄
rules.basis: 臓器提供意思は機微な情報とされ、オンライン本人確認の実務でも覆った状態での提出を指示されることがある（携帯キャリア等の提出先の案内）。備考欄は住所変更等の確認に必要なため隠さない
rules.basisEn: An organ donation declaration is treated as sensitive information, and online identity-verification practice sometimes instructs submitting it covered (guidance from recipients such as mobile carriers). The remarks column is not hidden because it is needed to confirm address changes and the like.
